title: Forever Add-on Catalog: inferred tags
description: tags.json: tags chosen for entries whose author set none (no .toc Category, topics or override tags), from the add-on's name, summary, folders and README, by catalog ID. The generator uses them only for such entries and marks them from.tags "inferred". An empty list means none fit.

fingerprint.description: The first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the entry's name, summary and folders, one per line, when the tags were chosen.
